title: More, fewer, equal
examples: Teacher, how do I show that one group has more?
If I have three apples and you give me one more, how many do I have?
What does it mean if two groups are equal?

explain.say: Look at the two groups of toys. Count each group.

draw.text: Group A: 3 toys   Group B: 2 toys

explain.say: Group A has three toys. Group B has two toys. So group A has more.
Group B has two toys. Two is fewer than three. So group B has fewer.
Here are four blocks and four blocks. Both groups have the same number. They are equal.
You can match the toys in pairs, one from each group. The group with toys left over has more.

draw.text: Make pairs. Look for toys left over.

faq.q: What does 'more' mean when we talk about numbers?
faq.a: More means a bigger amount or a larger group of things. You can also ask which group has more.

faq.q: How do I know if two groups are equal?
faq.a: Two groups are equal if they have the exact same number of items. You can count them to check.
Fewer means a smaller number of things. Two cars is fewer than five cars.

faq.q: If I have five counters and get one more, how many do I have?
faq.a: You count the five counters and then count one more. You will have six counters in total.

faq.q: If I have eight grapes and eat two, how many are left?
faq.a: You start with eight and take away two. You have six grapes left.

facts: Comparing groups helps us know which group has the biggest amount.
Equal groups have the same number of items in them.
One more means adding one single item to a group.
One less means taking one single item away from a group.

quiz.say: Look at the two groups of apples. Tap the group with more.
quiz.why: Group A has five apples. Five is more than three.

wrong.1: Group B has three apples, which is fewer than five.
wrong.2: The groups have different numbers, five and three.

quiz.say: Look at the fish. Tap the group with fewer.
quiz.why: Group B has two fish. Two is fewer than four.

wrong.0: Group A has four fish, which is more than two.
wrong.2: The groups have different numbers, four and two.

quiz.say: Count each group. Tap what is true.
quiz.why: Each group has three. The same number means equal.

wrong.0: Group A has three, and group B has three too.
wrong.1: Group B has three, and group A has three too.
